title: Payload — profile.updated
$comment: Total replacement: an omitted field is cleared. No avatar and no links — an unverified link field on a public profile is a phishing surface that costs nothing to omit. additionalProperties is true by design: the versioning rules require that a new optional field survives a node that cannot interpret it, preserved byte-exactly for the digest. Every envelope field name is forbidden here (set to false): the convention that a payload never duplicates the envelope is enforced by the schema, not left to prose.
